definitions: A fan theory within the Sherlock fandom (BBC series) that suggests a romantic relationship between John Watson and Sherlock Holmes is being deliberately hidden or hinted at by the show's creators.
The collective belief among some fans that the writers of the BBC show Sherlock are intentionally teasing or suppressing a romantic pairing between the two main characters, John and Sherlock.
examples: Many fans who believe in the Johnlock Conspiracy analyze every episode for subtle clues.
The Johnlock Conspiracy has generated extensive discussions and fanfiction within the fandom.
Some viewers find the Johnlock Conspiracy to be a compelling interpretation of the show's subtext.
